version_strings.string: DCS-7517B1_FW_v2.01.00.pkg / DCS-7517 B1 Release Note for FW v2.01.doc

notes: 1QS8 container: 44B custom header (magic 1QS8, image 'rootfs+backup'@0x0C) + gzip(GNU tar); binwalk -Me extracts directly, no encryption, no squashfs.
Same spook platform as DCS-6517: bin/spook (~ARM uClibc) is main HTTP server with <% nvram_get %> .asp templates under www/, config logic in lib/libcgi.so.1.0, bin/httpd is a small helper.

No literal version strings in bin/, etc/, www/ or ELF strings (first 20 ELFs scanned); version is served at runtime from nvram Properties.Firmware.DLinkVersion, set only by scripts/chk_version.sh -> v2.01.00, consistent with manifest 201_all_en_20190520.
CVE-2025-6931/6932 anchor functions present: generate_pass_from_mac and g_F_n_GenPassForQlync imported by bin/httpd and defined in lib/libnvram.so.1.0.
etc/passwd -> /tmp/passwd (generated at runtime); rootfs has 789 regular files + 327 symlinks; tar mtimes 2018-08-29 match BuildDate.
